description: Structured snapshot of a server: identity, member counts, boost status, channel outline grouped by category, and role count. The natural first call when starting work on a server. The outline holds only channels the bot can see; hidden_from_bot says how many others exist when any do. A running pause on invites or DMs is reported too, and so are the emoji, sticker, and sound slots in use and what the boost level does not unlock yet (a banner, role icons, and so on).

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: get_server_overview
